title: Spread Payment Replicas Across Nodes
description:
**SITUATION:**

Last outage: all three Payment Handler copies landed on one node. That node rebooted — payments died cluster-wide. Finance wants replicas **spread out** so one machine failure cannot take every payment Pod with it.

This lab spreads Payment Handler replicas with **topology constraints / anti-affinity**. One node failure must not take every payment Pod at once.
**YOUR TASK:**

1. **Update** `payment-handler` with **pod anti-affinity** so replicas prefer different nodes.
2. Verify **3** Pods are Ready and not all on the same node (when capacity allows).

**SPEC:**

- Deployment name: `payment-handler` (do not rename)
- Replicas: **`3`**
- `affinity.podAntiAffinity.preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution`:
  - weight: `100`
  - topologyKey: `kubernetes.io/hostname`
  - labelSelector: `app=payment-handler`
- Ready: **3/3** Pods Ready

**CONSTRAINTS:**

- Manifest: `payment-antiaffinity-l28.yaml`.
- Use **podAntiAffinity** (preferred), not required — avoid unschedulable Pods on tiny clusters.
- Work only in your lab namespace (not `default`).

problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Spread Payment Replicas Across Nodes

Scale `payment-handler` to **3** replicas and add preferred pod anti-affinity so replicas prefer different nodes.

Docs: [Inter-pod anti-affinity](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#inter-pod-affinity-and-anti-affinity)

## Solution YAML

Save as `payment-antiaffinity-l28.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: payment-handler
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payment-handler
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: payment-handler
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: payment-handler
      containers:
        - name: payment-handler
          image: rithvikreddyalkanti/payment-handler:v1.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
```

## Declarative

```bash
kubectl apply -f payment-antiaffinity-l28.yaml
kubectl get deploy payment-handler
kubectl get pods -l app=payment-handler -o wide
```

Wait until **3/3** Pods are Ready, then **Submit**. Prefer soft anti-affinity so tiny clusters stay schedulable.
